title: Bananas

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Banana
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: A banana is a fruit. Bananas grow on plants in warm parts of the world. Most banana plants are in Southeast Asia. Historians think the first people to grow bananas lived in Papua New Guinea. Today people grow bananas in warm countries all around the world.
There are about 110 kinds of bananas. The banana that we usually eat is soft and sweet. Other bananas are firmer. People cook these bananas. They are called plantains.
